title: GuardianAgent: Policy-Conditioned Risk-Adaptive Anonymization with Verified Adversarial Escalation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29251v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Privacy protection for live web traffic requires more than detecting private spans. Agent-based privacy protection systems must determine whether an outgoing action complies with the destination site's privacy policy, then apply only the level of rewriting or sanitisation justified by the residual disclosure risk. We present GuardianAgent, a policy-conditioned anonymization framework that couples structured risk assessment with verified adaptive rewriting. GuardianAgent computes risk through AMRSF (Adaptive Multi-factor Risk Scoring Formula), an explicit controller that combines policy-violation likelihood with data sensitivity, recipient transmission, purpose legitimacy, contextual basis, and policy transparency, rather than relying on an LLM to assign risk directly. translated_title: GuardianAgent：策略条件化的风险自适应匿名化与经验证的对抗性升级
translated_abstract: 针对实时网络流量的隐私保护，仅检测隐私片段是不够的。基于智能体的隐私保护系统必须判断外发操作是否符合目标网站的隐私策略，然后仅应用与剩余泄露风险相称的改写或脱敏级别。我们提出了 GuardianAgent，一个策略条件化的匿名化框架，它将结构化风险评估与经验证的自适应改写相结合。GuardianAgent 通过 AMRSF（自适应多因素风险评分公式）计算风险——这是一个显式控制器，将策略违规可能性与数据敏感度、接收方传输、目的合法性、情境依据以及策略透明度相结合，而不是直接依赖大语言模型（LLM）来分配风险。该风险评分同时决定了允许/转换/拒绝的决策以及初始匿名化级别。为了提高效率，GuardianAgent 针对低不确定性情形采用证据性快速通道……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GuardianAgent 提出了一种策略条件化的隐私匿名化框架，用显式的自适应多因素风险评分公式（AMRSF）替代 LLM 直接打分，依据风险等级决定允许/转换/拒绝操作并自适应选择匿名化强度，并通过经验证的对抗性升级机制保障处理安全。
en_tdlr: GuardianAgent introduces a policy-conditioned anonymization framework that computes risk through an explicit Adaptive Multi-factor Risk Scoring Formula (AMRSF) instead of direct LLM risk assignment, driving allow/transform/deny decisions and adaptive anonymization levels with verified adversarial escalation.
